name: parallax-subtle
purpose: Apply a restrained scroll-linked transform cue to a stable media or feature element.

cwvImpact.rationale: A host-controlled state changes only transform and uses the bounded semantic motion tokens.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: Stops the transform transition and keeps the element at its unshifted final state.

cwvTripwire.longAnimation: A bounded host semantic duration token is required for the transform transition.
cwvTripwire.durationCap: Timing is limited to the host semantic duration tokens.
